steps.name: the Wayland hello client should be visible
I wait for the shell prompt
I type "find /session/wayland/windows" on the serial console
the latest serial output should contain "/session/wayland/windows/index"
I type "cat /session/wayland/windows/index" on the serial console
the latest serial output should contain "Thing-OS Wayland Lab"
the latest serial output should contain "Clock"
the latest serial output should contain "title="
I type "cat /session/wayland/components" on the serial console
the latest serial output should contain "xdg_toplevel"
I type "cat /session/wayland/events/latest" on the serial console
the latest serial output should contain "surface_committed"
